services.title: Services
services.hint: Display name, address and accent color of each service. The accent color is used for the service's buttons in the hub. A color reported by the service itself replaces it, unless you keep yours with the box below.
services.name: Display name
services.healthHint: Checked every 60 seconds from the server. Empty means no status.
services.lock: Keep this color even if the service reports one
services.lock.hint: A color reported by the service replaces the color set here, unless this box is ticked.
services.key.hint: Short name, 2 to 32 characters (a to z, 0 to 9, hyphen, underscore). It becomes the client ID and the prefix of the service's rights, and cannot be changed.
services.redirects.hint: One per line, exactly as the service sends them. https, http only for localhost, or the scheme of an app (for example myapp://callback). No wildcards.
services.secret.heading: Client secret
services.secret.warning: Copy it now and put it into the service. It is shown only once and cannot be shown again.
services.secret.confirm: Create a new secret? The old one stops working immediately. Update the service afterwards.
services.connection.hint: What the service needs to sign users in. The full description is in docs/INTEGRATION.md.
